need: An interval on overall balanced accuracy (and on p95 latency), so settle_cases can size the overall gate the pick clears by under a point
why: The recommendation's narrowest line is the overall gate; settle_cases reports it unsettled because the figure states no spread, though every cell's accuracy carries a half-width and counts that could be combined
workaround: Carry point_estimate:overall and point_estimate:p95 as open caveats with material_if clauses; the next step asks for a case-level interval on a fresh run; no figure typed

need: Block queries that name a target-matrix cell as the place (settle and levers sources), e.g. strata=['complex.news']
why: The claims turn on one cell, Complex x News; block_render refuses a cell id in query.strata for settle and levers, though settle_cases and levers_effects take the cell as a place
workaround: Show the whole settle table for the pick (nine cells plus two gates) and the prompt lever on overall balanced accuracy without intervals; the cell-level lever effect is cited in prose by its key

need: A joint-label confusion (true cell to predicted cell) for a classifier whose target is a crossed matrix
why: The per-axis confusions for Brisk-S few-shot and Nano-XS few-shot are nearly identical on complexity and on domain, yet the two differ clearly in the Complex x News cell; where those turns go is only visible in the joint table
workaround: Leave the confusion out (listed in omitted) and say where the loss sits from the cell accuracies and the two-arm comparison

need: A figure key for the interval of a measure that is the plain mean of disjoint cells (balanced accuracy here), combined from the cells' stated half-widths
why: Overall accuracy is the unweighted mean of the nine cell accuracies, each with a stated half-width, so its interval is derivable and settles the sampling-noise half of the pick's thinnest gate; no key prints it, so the page can only say it in words
workaround: Say in Method and the caveat, in words, that the combined cell spreads put the noise well inside the clearance; keep point_estimate:overall open for selection and fresh-turn drift; type no number

need: A filter that spells the cost multiple as a rounded N times (e.g. 21 times), keeping its own unit
why: cost.gap.<a>.<b>.multiple prints '21.05 times' unfiltered (false precision) and |int prints a bare '21' with the unit dropped, against the rule that a key prints its own unit; no filter reads '21 times'
workaround: Write '{cost.gap.brisk-s.few.nano-xs.few.multiple|int} times as much', typing the unit word after the bare integer
